description: failure-classification tokens, rescue strategies, typed error codes

rescue_strategies.fresh_hessian_mode_monitor: restart with fresh Hessian while monitoring the target mode
rescue_strategies.irc_midpoint_recovery: re-seed from the IRC midpoint (collapsed INT recovery)
rescue_strategies.mode_displacement: displace ±0.30 Å along the imaginary mode
rescue_strategies.saddle_break: displace along the second imaginary mode to break the saddle
rescue_strategies.scf_damp_shift: SOSCF with damping and level shift
rescue_strategies.scf_slowconv: increase SCF MaxIter to 500 with SlowConv strategy
rescue_strategies.scf_soscf: increase SCF MaxIter to 500 with SOSCF strategy
rescue_strategies.ts_mode_directed: re-run with TS_Mode targeting the lowest imaginary mode
